class Rect { int left, top, right, bottom; int width() { return right - left; } int height() { return bottom - top; } }
class RectF { float left, top, right, bottom; void set(float a,float b,float c,float d) {} }
class Path { enum Direction { CW } void rewind() {} void addRoundRect(RectF r,float[] f,Direction d) {} }
class Canvas {
    final Map<Drawable, Integer> alphas = new IdentityHashMap<>();
    final List<Double> layerOpacity = new ArrayList<>(List.of(1.0));
    int alpha(Drawable d) { return alphas.getOrDefault(d, -1); }
    void record(Drawable d, int a) { alphas.put(d, (int)Math.round(a * layerOpacity.get(layerOpacity.size()-1))); }
    int save() { int n = layerOpacity.size(); layerOpacity.add(layerOpacity.get(n-1)); return n; }
    int saveLayerAlpha(float l,float t,float r,float b,int a) {
        int n = save(); layerOpacity.set(n, layerOpacity.get(n) * a / 255.0); return n;
    }
    int saveLayer(float l,float t,float r,float b,Paint p) { return saveLayerAlpha(l,t,r,b,p == null ? 255 : p.alpha); }
    void restore() { layerOpacity.remove(layerOpacity.size()-1); }
    void restoreToCount(int n) { while (layerOpacity.size() > n) restore(); }
    void clipRect(float a,float b,float c,float d) {}
    void drawColor(int c) {} void clipPath(Path p) {} void scale(float a,float b,float c,float d) {}
}
class Drawable { void setAlpha(int a) {} void setColorFilter(ColorFilter f) {} }
class BitmapDrawable extends Drawable { Bitmap getBitmap() { return new Bitmap(); } }
class ReactionLastFrame extends BitmapDrawable {}
class ExtendedBitmapDrawable extends BitmapDrawable { int getOrientation() { return 0; } int getInvert() { return 0; } }
class RLottieDrawable extends BitmapDrawable {
    boolean ready, publishOnNextRead;
    long publishedAt = Long.MIN_VALUE;
    boolean hasBitmap() {
        boolean result = ready;
        if (publishOnNextRead) { publishOnNextRead = false; ready = true; publishedAt = SystemClock.now; }
        return result;
    }
    boolean hasRenderingBitmap() { return hasBitmap() && SystemClock.now > publishedAt; }
    void updateCurrentFrame(long time, boolean background) {}
    void addParentView(ImageReceiver r) {} void removeParentView(ImageReceiver r) {}
    boolean isHeavyDrawable() { return false; } void start() {} void recycle(boolean b) {}
    void setAllowDecodeSingleFrame(boolean b) {} void setAutoRepeat(int n) {} void setAutoRepeatCount(int n) {}
    void setAutoRepeatTimeout(long n) {} void setAllowDrawFramesWhileCacheGenerating(boolean b) {}
}
class AnimatedFileDrawable extends BitmapDrawable {
    boolean ready, publishOnNextRead, isWebmSticker = true;
    boolean hasBitmap() {
        boolean result = ready;
        if (publishOnNextRead) { publishOnNextRead = false; ready = true; }
        return result;
    }
    void setStartEndTime(long a,long b) {} long getLastFrameTimestamp() { return 0; }
    void seekTo(long n,boolean a,boolean b) {} void addParent(ImageReceiver r) {} void removeParent(ImageReceiver r) {}
    void setUseSharedQueue(boolean b) {} void checkRepeat() {} void setAllowDecodeSingleFrame(boolean b) {}
    void setRoundRadius(int[] a) {} void recycle() {} void stop() {} List<Object> getParents() { return List.of(); }
}

class ImageReceiver {
    /* PREVIEW_APPEARANCE */
    static final int LOAD_TYPE_COUNT = 4;
    static final PorterDuffXfermode CROSSFADE_ADD = new PorterDuffXfermode(PorterDuff.Mode.ADD);
    final Paint crossfadePaint = new Paint();
    volatile int loadingPresentationGeneration, loadingPlaceholderGeneration = -1, loadingBlankGeneration = -1;
    volatile Drawable presentedImagePreview;
    volatile int presentedImagePreviewGeneration = -1;
    PreviewAppearance previewAppearance;
    static final int TYPE_IMAGE = 0, TYPE_THUMB = 1, TYPE_CROSSFDADE = 2, TYPE_MEDIA = 3;
    boolean manualAlphaAnimator, crossfadeOnReady, crossfadeFromImage, drawWithoutLoadFade, currentKeyQuality;
    boolean clip = true, isRoundVideo;
    Drawable crossfadeOnReadyDrawable;
    Drawable currentMediaDrawable, currentImageDrawable, currentThumbDrawable, staticThumbDrawable, crossfadeImage;
    String currentImageKey = "image", currentMediaKey = "media", currentThumbKey = "thumb", crossfadeKey;
    BitmapShader mediaShader, imageShader, thumbShader, staticThumbShader, crossfadeShader;
    float currentAlpha = 1, previousAlpha = 1, overrideAlpha = 1, pressedProgress, crossfadeByScale = .05f;
    long lastUpdateAlphaTime, lastPressedAnimationTime, startTime, endTime, autoRepeatTimeout, currentSize, currentTime;
    int crossfadeDuration = 150, currentGuid = 1, currentAccount, invalidations;
    byte crossfadeAlpha = 1;
    boolean isVisible = true, useRoundRadius = true, useRoundForThumb, videoThumbIsSame = true, attachedToWindow = true;
    boolean crossfadeWithThumb, crossfadeWithOldImage, crossfadingWithThumb, forcePreview, forceNotMedia, forceCrossfade;
    boolean allowStartAnimation = true, allowStartLottieAnimation = true, allowDecodeSingleFrame;
    boolean useSharedAnimationQueue, allowDrawWhileCacheGenerating, animationReadySent, ignoreNotifications;
    int isPressed, animateFromIsPressed, currentOpenedLayerFlags, autoRepeat, autoRepeatCount;
    int imageOrientation, imageInvert, thumbOrientation, thumbInvert, currentCacheType;
    float imageX, imageY, imageW, imageH;
    final int[] roundRadius = new int[4], emptyRoundRadius = new int[4];
    final float[] radii = new float[8];
    final Path roundPath = new Path();
    final Paint roundPaint = new Paint();
    Bitmap gradientBitmap;
    ColorFilter colorFilter;
    Object currentParentObject, currentImageLocation, currentMediaLocation, currentThumbLocation;
    String currentMediaFilter, currentImageFilter, currentThumbFilter, currentExt;
    SetImageBackup setImageBackup;
    View parentView;
    Runnable invalidateRunnable = this::invalidate;
    ArrayList<Decorator> decorators;
    Delegate delegate;
    static class Delegate {
        void onAnimationReady(ImageReceiver r) {} void didSetImageBitmap(int t,String k,Drawable d) {}
        void didSetImage(ImageReceiver r,boolean a,boolean b,boolean c) {}
    }
    static class Decorator { void onDraw(Canvas c, ImageReceiver r) {} void onDetachedFromWidnow() {} }
    static class SetImageBackup {
        Object mediaLocation, imageLocation, thumbLocation, parentObject;
        String mediaFilter, imageFilter, thumbFilter, ext;
        Drawable thumb; long size; int cacheType;
        void clear() { mediaLocation = null; imageLocation = null; thumbLocation = null; parentObject = null; thumb = null; }
    }
    void invalidate() { invalidations++; }
    void setAllowLoadingOnAttachedOnly(boolean b) {}
    boolean hasImageLoaded() { return currentImageDrawable != null || currentMediaDrawable != null; }
    boolean hasReadyImage() { return hasImageLoaded(); }
    boolean hasPresentedView() { return false; }
    boolean draw(Canvas canvas) { return draw(canvas, null); }
    void updateDrawableRadius(Drawable d) {} void completeFailedLoadRetry(String k, int t) {}
    void trackStickerFirstFrame(String k,int t,int g,Drawable d) {} void resetFailedLoadRetry() {}
    void setStaticDrawable(Drawable d) { staticThumbDrawable = d; }
    int getCurrentAccount() { return currentAccount; }
    float getCenterX() { return 0; } float getCenterY() { return 0; }
    void drawDrawable(Canvas canvas, Drawable d, int alpha, BitmapShader s, int o, int i, BackgroundThreadDrawHolder h) {
        if (isAnimatedDrawableReady(d)) canvas.record(d, alpha);
    }
    // Loader acceptance and frame selection/fading are not mocked.
    boolean deliver(Drawable d, int t, boolean cached) {
        return setImageBitmapByKey(d, t == TYPE_MEDIA ? currentMediaKey : t == TYPE_IMAGE ? currentImageKey : currentThumbKey,
                                   t, cached, currentGuid);
    }
    Canvas frame(long time, boolean background) {
        SystemClock.now = time;
        Canvas canvas = new Canvas();
        draw(canvas, background ? setDrawInBackgroundThread(null, 0) : null);
        return canvas;
    }
    // Only used by the forum identity test; production setImageBitmap's slot contract.
    void setImageBitmap(Drawable d) { staticThumbDrawable = d; }
    /* RECEIVER */
}

    void invalidate() {} void updateAttachState() {}
    ImageReceiver receiver() { createImageReceiver(); return imageReceiver; }
    /* IDENTITY */
    /* FACTORY */
}

public class EmojiFirstFrameHarness {
    static void check(boolean value, String message) { if (!value) throw new AssertionError(message); }
    static int cacheType = AnimatedEmojiDrawable.CACHE_TYPE_MESSAGES;
    static ImageReceiver receiver() { return new AnimatedEmojiDrawable(cacheType, 0, 1).receiver(); }
    static void completeFade(ImageReceiver r, Drawable d, long start, boolean background) {
        int previous = 0;
        for (long now = start; now <= start + 300; now += 15) {
            int a = r.frame(now, background).alpha(d);
            check(a >= previous && a <= 255, "bounded monotonic fade: " + a);
            check(a - previous <= 28, "no visible first-frame alpha jump: " + a + " after " + previous);
            previous = a;
        }
        check(previous == 255, "fade completes");
    }
    static void cold(boolean cached, boolean media, boolean webm, boolean background, boolean preview) {
        ImageReceiver r = receiver();
        Drawable d = webm ? new AnimatedFileDrawable() : new RLottieDrawable();
        Drawable thumb = new BitmapDrawable();
        if (preview) r.deliver(thumb, ImageReceiver.TYPE_IMAGE, true);
        check(r.deliver(d, media ? ImageReceiver.TYPE_MEDIA : ImageReceiver.TYPE_IMAGE, cached), "accepted");
        for (int n = 0; n < 12; n++) {
            Canvas c = r.frame(1000 + 1000 * n, background);
            check(c.alpha(d) == -1, "no undecoded pixels");
            if (preview) check(c.alpha(thumb) == 255, "preview stays visible");
            check(r.currentAlpha == 0, "pending fade never progresses");
        }
        if (webm) ((AnimatedFileDrawable)d).ready = true; else ((RLottieDrawable)d).ready = true;
        check(r.frame(30000, background).alpha(d) == 0, "first decoded frame transparent");
        completeFade(r, d, 30000, background);
        r.deliver(d, media ? ImageReceiver.TYPE_MEDIA : ImageReceiver.TYPE_IMAGE, true);
        check(r.frame(40000, background).alpha(d) == 255, "same cached identity never refades");
    }
    static void staticAndCached() {
        ImageReceiver r = receiver();
        BitmapDrawable d = new BitmapDrawable();
        r.deliver(d, ImageReceiver.TYPE_IMAGE, false);
        check(r.frame(50000, false).alpha(d) == 0, "async static emoji fades without thumb");
        completeFade(r, d, 50000, false);
        r = receiver(); r.deliver(d, ImageReceiver.TYPE_IMAGE, true);
        check(r.frame(60000, false).alpha(d) == 255, "ready cached static immediate");
        RLottieDrawable l = new RLottieDrawable(); l.ready = true;
        r = receiver(); r.deliver(l, ImageReceiver.TYPE_IMAGE, true);
        check(r.frame(60000, false).alpha(l) == 255, "ready cached lottie immediate");
    }
    static void readinessRace(boolean background, boolean media, boolean preview, boolean webm) {
        ImageReceiver r = receiver();
        Drawable d = webm ? new AnimatedFileDrawable() : new RLottieDrawable();
        BitmapDrawable thumb = new BitmapDrawable();
        if (preview) r.deliver(thumb, ImageReceiver.TYPE_IMAGE, true);
        r.deliver(d, media ? ImageReceiver.TYPE_MEDIA : ImageReceiver.TYPE_IMAGE, true);
        // Simulate a worker publishing immediately after prepare's false readiness
        // read. A second hasBitmap() in this snapshot would now return true.
        if (webm) ((AnimatedFileDrawable)d).publishOnNextRead = true;
        else ((RLottieDrawable)d).publishOnNextRead = true;
        Canvas raced = r.frame(90000, background);
        check(raced.alpha(d) == -1, "race snapshot must keep pending frame hidden");
        if (preview) check(raced.alpha(thumb) == 255, "race snapshot retains preview");
        check(r.currentAlpha == 0 && r.crossfadeOnReadyDrawable == d, "race snapshot keeps fade pending");
        check(r.frame(90016, background).alpha(d) == 0, "next snapshot starts published frame at zero");
        completeFade(r, d, 90016, background);
    }
    static void lifecycle() {
        ImageReceiver r = receiver(); RLottieDrawable old = new RLottieDrawable();
        r.deliver(old, ImageReceiver.TYPE_MEDIA, true);
        r.onDetachedFromWindow();
        check(r.crossfadeOnReadyDrawable == null, "detach releases pending drawable");
        check(r.currentMediaDrawable == null, "detach releases media");
        old.ready = true;
        r.currentMediaKey = "media"; r.attachedToWindow = true;
        r.deliver(old, ImageReceiver.TYPE_MEDIA, true);
        check(r.frame(70000, false).alpha(old) == 255, "reattach to decoded cache does not refade");
        RLottieDrawable next = new RLottieDrawable();
        r.deliver(next, ImageReceiver.TYPE_MEDIA, false);
        check(!r.setImageBitmapByKey(old, "obsolete", ImageReceiver.TYPE_MEDIA, false, r.currentGuid), "stale key rejected");
        check(!r.setImageBitmapByKey(old, "media", ImageReceiver.TYPE_MEDIA, false, r.currentGuid - 1), "stale guid rejected");
        check(r.crossfadeOnReadyDrawable == next, "stale delivery leaves replacement intact");
        next.ready = true;
        check(r.frame(71000, false).alpha(next) == 0, "replacement gets its own fade");
        completeFade(r, next, 71000, false);
        r.deliver(new RLottieDrawable(), ImageReceiver.TYPE_MEDIA, false);
        r.setCurrentAccount(1);
        check(r.crossfadeOnReadyDrawable == null, "account change clears pending identity");
        r.clearImage();
        check(r.crossfadeOnReadyDrawable == null, "clear releases pending drawable");
    }
    static void latePreviewAndOwnedTransition() {
        ImageReceiver r = receiver(); RLottieDrawable d = new RLottieDrawable();
        r.deliver(d, ImageReceiver.TYPE_MEDIA, true);
        BitmapDrawable preview = new BitmapDrawable();
        r.deliver(preview, ImageReceiver.TYPE_IMAGE, true);
        check(r.crossfadeOnReadyDrawable == d && r.currentAlpha == 0, "late cached preview preserves pending media");
        check(r.frame(80000, false).alpha(preview) == 255, "late preview visible");
        d.ready = true;
        SystemClock.now = 81000;
        Canvas owned = new Canvas();
        r.drawWithoutLoadFade(owned);
        check(owned.alpha(d) == 255, "explicit status fade remains sole owner");
        check(r.frame(81000, false).alpha(d) == 0, "shared ordinary consumer retains load fade");
        completeFade(r, d, 81000, false);
    }
    static void optOuts() {
        for (int mode = 0; mode < 7; mode++) {
            ImageReceiver r = receiver();
            if (mode == 0) r.setCrossfadeOnReady(false);
            if (mode == 1) r.manualAlphaAnimator = true;
            if (mode == 2) r.crossfadeDuration = 0;
            if (mode == 3) r.crossfadeAlpha = 0;
            if (mode == 4) r.forcePreview = true;
            if (mode == 5) r.crossfadeWithOldImage = true;
            if (mode == 6) r.isVisible = false;
            RLottieDrawable d = new RLottieDrawable(); r.deliver(d, ImageReceiver.TYPE_IMAGE, true);
            check(r.crossfadeOnReadyDrawable == null, "intentional transition/opt-out preserved " + mode);
        }
        ImageReceiver export = new AnimatedEmojiDrawable(AnimatedEmojiDrawable.CACHE_TYPE_RENDERING_VIDEO, 0, 1).receiver();
        check(!export.crossfadeOnReady, "video export is not visually changed");
        ImageReceiver ordinaryImage = new ImageReceiver();
        check(!ordinaryImage.crossfadeOnReady, "generic images remain opt-out by default");
    }
    static void forum() {
        TLRPC.TL_forumTopic t = new TLRPC.TL_forumTopic();
        ImageReceiver r = receiver(); Context context = new Context();
        ForumUtilities.setTopicIcon(context, r, t, false, false, null);
        Drawable first = r.getDrawable();
        ForumUtilities.setTopicIcon(context, r, t, false, false, null);
        check(first == r.getDrawable(), "forum receiver same identity retains icon");
        t.icon_emoji_id++;
        ForumUtilities.setTopicIcon(context, r, t, false, false, null);
        check(first != r.getDrawable(), "forum replacement changes icon");
        first = r.getDrawable(); UserConfig.selectedAccount++;
        r.setCurrentAccount(UserConfig.selectedAccount);
        ForumUtilities.setTopicIcon(context, r, t, false, false, null);
        check(first != r.getDrawable(), "forum account changes identity");
        first = r.getDrawable();
        ForumUtilities.setTopicIcon(context, r, t, false, true, null);
        check(first != r.getDrawable(), "forum size/cache changes identity");
        BackupImageView view = new BackupImageView();
        ForumUtilities.setTopicIcon(view, t);
        first = view.animatedEmojiDrawable;
        ForumUtilities.setTopicIcon(view, t);
        check(first == view.animatedEmojiDrawable, "backup same identity retains icon");
        UserConfig.selectedAccount++;
        view.getImageReceiver().setCurrentAccount(UserConfig.selectedAccount);
        ForumUtilities.setTopicIcon(view, t);
        check(first != view.animatedEmojiDrawable, "backup account changes identity");
        t.id = 1; ForumUtilities.setTopicIcon(view, t);
        check(view.animatedEmojiDrawable == null, "general topic clears emoji");
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        for (int type : new int[]{AnimatedEmojiDrawable.CACHE_TYPE_MESSAGES,
                                  AnimatedEmojiDrawable.CACHE_TYPE_MESSAGES_LARGE,
                                  AnimatedEmojiDrawable.CACHE_TYPE_FORUM_TOPIC,
                                  AnimatedEmojiDrawable.CACHE_TYPE_FORUM_TOPIC_LARGE,
                                  AnimatedEmojiDrawable.CACHE_TYPE_FORUM_TOPIC_PULL_DOWN,
                                  AnimatedEmojiDrawable.CACHE_TYPE_ALERT_PREVIEW_STATIC}) {
            cacheType = type;
        for (boolean cached : new boolean[]{false, true})
            for (boolean media : new boolean[]{false, true})
                for (boolean webm : new boolean[]{false, true})
                    for (boolean background : new boolean[]{false, true}) {
                        cold(cached, media, webm, background, false);
                        if (media) cold(cached, media, webm, background, true);
                        if (cached) {
                            readinessRace(background, media, false, webm);
                            if (media) readinessRace(background, media, true, webm);
                        }
                    }
        }
        staticAndCached(); lifecycle(); latePreviewAndOwnedTransition(); optOuts(); forum();
        System.out.println("PASS: emoji first-frame pipeline (144 cold-load/cache-type combinations + 72 readiness races + cache/replacement/lifecycle/ownership/forum)");
    }
}
